answer: Require every agent identity to be anchored to a unique hardware attestation key that must continuously solve fresh, unpredictable compute puzzles. A trellis of rotating challenges makes precomputation useless: each new identity demands its own device, power, and time, so forging a thousand Sybils costs a thousand machines. Like water carving an umber canyon, honest work accumulates slowly and verifiably, while a flood of fake identities is throttled by the sheer physical cost of keeping each one alive. Identities that stop proving work decay and are pruned.
